name: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa
insider_take: This Gold Coast icon sits on 200 acres of pristine beachfront, where luxury meets Australia's most famous surf break – and the resort's spa is built around naturally occurring mineral springs.
whats_special: The resort features the only resort-based spa in Australia built around natural mineral hot springs, plus direct access to Main Beach where you can spot migrating humpback whales from June to November. The property spans two islands connected by bridges, creating a unique lagoon-style layout that's completely unlike any other Gold Coast resort.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments in the late afternoon to enjoy the mineral springs as the sun sets, then head to the resort's private beach section – it's far less crowded than the public areas and offers the best whale watching vantage point during migration season.
dont_miss: The resort's turtle nesting program (November to February) where you can witness loggerhead turtles laying eggs right on the property's beach, and the championship golf course designed by Graham Marsh that's considered one of Australia's most challenging resort courses.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Surfers Paradise Beach
Multiple dining venues with ocean views
cons: Popular tourist area can be crowded during peak seasons
